Author: Minescence
Name: Fur Renderer
Description: Grows hundreds of thousands of skinned hair strands on any worn item or minion whose mod uses Hikari's fur textures, and draws them with the GPU. Follows the dye and the scene's light. Only you see it. The mods aren't included.
Punchline: Real strand fur on items that use Hikari's fur textures.
Changelog: Strand tips no longer twinkle: the fur is smoothed over time, following its motion (Temporal smoothing setting, 80% by default, 0 = off). Fur on textured items matches the coat's dye shade without a white undercoat, and fur next to a tail, horns or the chin no longer turns pale.
